description: This Java source file implements the Pascal distribution as a class extending an abstract integer distribution, providing methods for probability calculations, access to parameters, and statistical properties.

classes.name: PascalDistribution
classes.description: Implements the Pascal distribution, modeling the distribution of the number of failures before a specified number of successes occurs in a sequence of Bernoulli trials.

methods.name: getNumberOfSuccesses
methods.description: Returns the number of successes parameter, r, for the Pascal distribution.

methods.name: getProbabilityOfSuccess
methods.description: Returns the probability of success, p, parameter for the Pascal distribution.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability mass function P(X = x) for a given number of failures x.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the probability mass function for a given x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative distribution function P(X <= x) for a given x.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution, calculated as r * (1 - p) / p.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution, calculated as r * (1 - p) / p^2.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support, which is always 0.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support, represented as Integer.MAX_VALUE.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Confirms that the support of the distribution is connected, returning true.
